name: confession_pool
purpose: Formulation pool for data/atlas/v2/confession_neutral.jsonl. Each row draws one formulation per slot (seed = problem_id); slots D0,D1,D2,D3,D4,E are chosen as the combination whose after-fence length is closest to target_after_fence. Rows are regenerable from (pool, function name, return literal, slot_ids). If the seeded draw of A/B/C/format cannot reach window_after_fence with any D0..E combination, the next seeded draw is taken (attempt index recorded as draw_attempt in slot_ids).
